name: clank-harness
description: Local-first, provider-agnostic coding-agent harness with a VS Code client.

scripts.build:packages: tsc -p packages/agent-core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/providers/openai-compatible/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/workspace-tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/checkpoints/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/storage/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/vscode-extension run compile
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/providers/openai-compatible/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/workspace-tools/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/checkpoints/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/storage/tsconfig.json && npm --prefix apps/vscode-extension run typecheck
scripts.test: bun test packages/agent-core/test packages/providers/openai-compatible/test packages/workspace-tools/test packages/checkpoints/test packages/storage/test apps/vscode-extension/test
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm --prefix apps/vscode-extension run smoke:bundle
